layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: FastAPI HTTP server exposing OpenAI-compatible chat completions and image generation, with request/response adapters for Claude, Ollama, and OpenAI Responses.

layers.name: Cluster Control Plane
layers.description: Cluster coordination: master election and model placement, zenoh pub/sub event routing, and the distributed model download coordinator.

layers.name: Inference Worker Layer
layers.description: Inference workers: MLX and image engine builders, runner supervision, disaggregated serving, and shard management on each node.

layers.name: Shared Foundation & Utilities
layers.description: Shared foundation: event-sourcing types and cluster state models, model card schemas, constants, topology, election protocol, and cross-cutting Python utilities.

layers.name: Test Suite
layers.description: Unit tests co-located under module test directories plus top-level multi-node integration tests, fixtures, and harnesses.

layers.name: Client Applications
layers.description: Client applications: the Svelte 5 + TypeScript dashboard frontend and the native Swift EXO menu-bar app for iOS/macOS.

layers.name: Rust Networking Core
layers.description: Rust components: zenoh networking primitives, PyO3 exo_rs bindings exposing networking to Python, and system custodian operations.

layers.name: Model Card Data
layers.description: TOML model card definitions declaring supported inference and image-generation models with their shard layouts and quantization variants.

layers.name: Vendored Type Stubs
layers.description: Vendored .pyi type stubs for third-party MLX, mflux, pynvml, and safetensors dependencies used to satisfy strict type checking.

layers.name: Infrastructure, Config & Tooling
layers.description: Build and CI/CD configuration, nix packaging, DMG/pyinstaller distribution, benchmarks, helper scripts, editor/agent configs, and project documentation.
